name: Chaweng
description: The main tourist hub with the longest beach on Koh Samui. Lots of nightlife, restaurants, and shopping.

name: Lamai
description: Second largest town, known for spa and wellness centers. More relaxed atmosphere than Chaweng.

name: Bophut (Fisherman's Village)
description: Charming fishing village with French colonial architecture. Great restaurants and boutique hotels.

name: Maenam
description: Peaceful northern beach with long stretches of sand. Good for families and digital nomads.

name: Choeng Mon
description: Upscale area with beach clubs and luxury resorts. Small but beautiful beach.

name: Big Buddha Beach
description: Named after the iconic Big Buddha temple nearby. Convenient location near the airport.

name: Taling Ngam
description: Southwest coast with stunning sunset views. Luxury resorts and pristine nature.

name: Nathon
description: Capital of Koh Samui. Main ferry terminal for connections to mainland and other islands.

name: Lipa Noi
description: West coast with beautiful sunsets and family-friendly beach. Quieter area.

name: Bang Por
description: Northern coast with laid-back vibe. Popular with expats and long-term travelers.
